Trust installs a peer's public bundle (from its "agent bus init",
"agent bus export" or "agent bus rename"). Check the key and pin it prints
against the peer's own output before relying on the link. Re-trusting a
host replaces its bundle. Restart the bus to apply: agent bus restart.

A peer renamed with "agent bus rename" keeps its keys: trust its new
bundle with --renames <old name>. That checks the bundle has the old
name's key and certificate pin, replaces the old bundle, rewrites this
host's references to the old name (its agents' spawned_by, friction
links, its ssh destination), keeps the old name as an alias, and restarts
the bus (--no-restart skips that).

Usage:
  agent bus trust <bundle.json | -> [flags]

Examples:
  agent bus trust hub.pub.json
  agent bus trust - < hub.pub.json
  agent bus trust new-name.pub.json --renames old-name

Flags:
  -h, --help             help for trust
      --no-restart       With --renames: don't restart the bus
      --renames string   The peer's former name: its bundle has the same keys under a new name (agent bus rename)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
